findings.evidence: AccessMethods.lean:108-109 `def q2Sigma ... := -g_met d.kOut d.kOut`; AccessMethods.lean:121-122 `0 ≤ q2Sigma d g_met := neg_nonneg.mpr hKOut`. `neg_nonneg` is Mathlib's ordered-group lemma (used e.g. mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Ring/Unbundled/Basic.lean:743, mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Nonneg/Ring.lean:76).
findings.fix: Delete `SigmaMethodData.q2Sigma_nonneg`; it has no consumers anywhere (grep for `q2Sigma` matches only this file), and any future caller writes `neg_nonneg.mpr h` directly.
findings.issue: `q2Sigma_nonneg` adds nothing over Mathlib's `neg_nonneg`: `q2Sigma d g_met` is `-g_met d.kOut d.kOut` by `rfl`, so the statement is `neg_nonneg` at that term — as the PR's own new proof body `neg_nonneg.mpr hKOut` shows. The PR deleted the analogous `Q2_JB_def_consistent` and `W2_JB_physical_region` in this same file but kept this one.

findings.evidence: AccessMethods.lean:176-177 `def q2JB (_d : JBMethodData V) (g_met) (k_out) : ℝ := -g_met k_out k_out`; AccessMethods.lean:108-109 `def q2Sigma ... := -g_met d.kOut d.kOut`; EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:52-53 `def Q2 (g : Bilin V) (K : DisKinematics V) : ℝ := - g K.q K.q`.
findings.fix: Delete `q2JB` and inline `-g_met k_out k_out` in `xBjJB` (line 185), or route both method namespaces through the existing `Kinematics.Q2` so there is one definition of the hard scale.
findings.issue: `JBMethodData.q2JB` is a clone of `SigmaMethodData.q2Sigma` and of `Kinematics.Q2`: all three are `fun g v => -g v v`. `q2JB` discards its `JBMethodData` argument entirely (`_d`), so it carries no JB-specific content. The PR removed the `rfl` lemma that stated this (`Q2_JB_def_consistent`) but kept the redundant definition, leaving three spellings of the same function in one directory.

findings.evidence: StructureConstants.lean:16-24 (provenance text) vs. StructureConstants.lean:76 `lemma repr_lie_basis (i j k : ι) : b.repr ⁅b i, b j⁆ k = structureConstants b i j k := rfl`, replacing the upstream `coord_lie_basis`; namespace is `EpsilonEridani` at line 60.
findings.fix: Update the provenance paragraph to record the `coord_lie_basis` → `repr_lie_basis` deviation (and the proof changes at lines 87, 114, 128), and fix the `Physlib` → `EpsilonEridani` namespace reference while there.
findings.issue: The provenance block states the file is a diffable mirror of mathlib branch `m3-lie-structure-constants` commit `e14396d8` and that "the only edits are the `Physlib` namespace wrapper, the `theorem` -> `lemma` conversion ... and the `open`". This PR renames and restates `coord_lie_basis` to `repr_lie_basis` and rewrites three dependent proofs, so the claim is now false and the documented deletion/rename migration no longer matches upstream. (The same paragraph also says `Physlib.LieAlgebra.structureConstants` while the actual namespace is `EpsilonEridani.LieAlgebra`.)

summary: The renames and the OneLoopScalars/CasimirDerivation changes introduce no duplicate API. But in AccessMethods.lean the PR deleted three vacuous lemmas while leaving two more instances of the same pattern (q2Sigma_nonneg is literally neg_nonneg.mpr; q2JB is a clone of q2Sigma and of Kinematics.Q2), and the StructureConstants provenance note now misstates how the file diverges from its upstream mirror.
